title: Standards and Proposals
blurb: Specifications, protocols, and conventions that let agents discover, read, and act on the web.

title: WebMCP and In-Page Agent Tools
blurb: Libraries and demos that let a web page expose tools to agents, and MCP running in or alongside the browser.

title: Browser-Use Frameworks
blurb: Open-source libraries and SDKs that let LLMs drive a browser to complete tasks.

title: Browser MCP Servers
blurb: MCP servers that give assistants control of, or insight into, a real browser.

title: Computer-Use Agents
blurb: Agents, sandboxes, and tooling that operate full graphical desktops from screenshots and actions.

title: Automation Foundations
blurb: The browser automation engines and headless browsers that agent frameworks build on.

title: Headless Browser Infrastructure
blurb: Self-hostable and hosted browser fleets built for agent workloads.

title: Web Data for Agents
blurb: Crawlers, readers, and extraction tools that turn pages into agent-ready content.

title: Benchmarks and Research
blurb: Datasets, environments, and research agents for measuring and improving web agents.
